profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa and listed under the ticker SHOP, with the SEC filing identifier 0001594805. Its website presents it as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses, offering a free trial and describing itself as more than ecommerce software, with tools to manage every part of a business.

The site frames AI as central to how merchants build and grow. It says businesses can get discovered across AI channels and that shoppers can check out directly in a chat, a capability the company attributes to Agentic Storefronts.

The record holds no litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company.
